summary.text: Fetus Earth Maze is Lu Wei Yin's immortal killer move. It fuses three rank eight killer moves into a maze that traps the target inside his immortal battlefield.

claims.text: Inside an immortal battlefield in Southern Border, Lu Wei Yin stacks three immortal killer moves against Fang Yuan: Descending Sand, Mud Piled Into a Wall, and Six Directional Maze. Descending Sand rains sand that weakens Fang Yuan’s sword dragons into soft white earthworms; Mud Piled Into a Wall drinks battle will from allies and raises yellow walls that have no offense of their own; Six Directional Maze then closes the trap. The three fuse into Fetus Earth Maze, a huge maze like the core of a hollow mountain, with interwoven paths and walls that dizzy the eye. The text ranks that fusion as three rank eight killer moves combined. Fang Yuan loses sense of direction, forgets the path he walked, and finds attacks on the yellow walls extremely weak because those walls carry Descending Sand’s effect.

He refuses calls to kill Fang Yuan and states that Fetus Earth Maze can let a person live three lifetimes, experience mortal life fully, comprehend life and death, understand human ways, forget evil in the heart, and turn over a new leaf. He asks Shang Xin Ci to invest will into the maze so Fang Yuan feels it and meets the beauty of life.

He says his killer move mimics reincarnation battlefield and uses Fetus Earth Maze as the base to create a dream realm with many elite participants, so powerful that he can only influence it, not control it. The Virtue true inheritance inside that dream is a real setup meant to push Fang Yuan from demonic path toward righteous path through good deeds.
